title: The Science and Practice of Chess Improvement
subtitle: Train Deliberately. Think Clearly.
short_description: An evidence-informed guide to improving chess decisions, game analysis, and deliberate practice.
long_description: Improve your chess with a structured, evidence-informed system. Learn how to identify recurring errors in your own games, compare candidate moves, calculate critical variations, review without premature engine dependence, and turn each diagnosis into targeted practice. The guide includes a twelve-week (84-day) training curriculum, decision case cards, review templates, and practical exercises for a repeatable improvement routine.
